text:
tinue

  grep -RIl \
    --binary-files=without-match \
    "$TARGET_PATH" \
    "$base" 2>/dev/null \
    | head -n 100 \
    | while IFS= read -r f; do
        [ -r "$f" ] || continue

        echo "AUTOMATION_REFERENCE_FILE=$f"

        stat -c \
          'AUTOMATION_REFERENCE_STAT path=%n mtime=%y size=%s uid=%u gid=%g mode=%a' \
          "$f" 2>/dev/null || true

        grep -nE \
          "$TARGET_PATH|feature/GRU|deploy_feature_gru|git[[:space:]].*(fetch|pull|checkout|reset)" \
          "$f" 2>/dev/null \
          | head -n 80 \
          | sed -E \
            's/([A-Za-z0-9_]*(TOKEN|PASSWORD|SECRET|KEY)[A-Za-z0-9_]*)=[^[:space:]]+/\1=<REDACTED>/Ig' \
          | sed 's/^/AUTOMATION_REFERENCE /' \
          || true
      done
done

###############################################################################
# 7. Final classification.
###############################################################################

echo
echo "===== AUTOMATION PROVENANCE CLASSIFICATION ====="

echo "GITHUBACTIONS_CRON_RELEVANT=$CRON_RELEVANT"
echo "SYSTEM_CRON_RELEVANT=$SYSTEM_CRON_RELEVANT"
echo "SYSTEMD_RELEVANT=$SYSTEMD_RELEVANT"

if [ "$CRON_RELEVANT" -eq 1 ] || \
   [ "$SYSTEM_CRON_RELEVANT" -eq 1 ] || \
   [ "$SYSTEMD_RELEVANT" -eq 1 ]; then

  echo "AUTOMATION_PROVENANCE=RELEVANT_MECHANISM_FOUND"
else
  echo "AUTOMATION_PROVENANCE=NO_RELEVANT_MECHANISM_FOUND"
fi

echo
echo "REMOTE_MUTATION=NO"
echo "CRONTAB_MUTATION=NO"
echo "SYSTEMD_MUTATION=NO"
echo "PROCESS_SIGNAL=NO"
echo "SERVICE_ACTION=NO"
echo "GIT_MUTATION=NO"
echo "FETCH_PULL_CHECKOUT_RESET=NO"
echo "SEMAPHORE_QUERY=NO"
echo "GITHUB_QUERY=NO"
echo "DEPLOYMENT=NO"
echo "READONLY_VPS_AUTOMATION_PROVENANCE=PASS"
REMOTE
)"

set +e
"$VPS" "$REMOTE_SCRIPT" \
  >"$E/automation-provenance.txt" 2>&1
rc=$?
set -e

cat "$E/automation-provenance.txt"

if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "READONLY_VPS_AUTOMATION_PROVENANCE=FAILED"
  echo "VPS_WRAPPER_EXIT_CODE=$rc"
  echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"
  exit "$rc"
fi

echo
echo "===== LOCAL EVIDENCE DIGEST ====="

sha256sum "$E/automation-provenance.txt"

echo
echo "LOCAL_ONLY_EVIDENCE_WRITE=YES"
echo "VPS_MUTATION=NO"
echo "SEMAPHORE_MUTATION=NO"
echo "SOURCE_REPOSITORY_MUTATION=NO"
echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"
